name: Andy Cowell
satirical_angle: The engine genius who built Mercedes' turbo-hybrid dynasty, now thrown into a team where he has to manage Adrian Newey's god complex, Lawrence Stroll's chequebook, Fernando's complaints, and Lance's existence - all while his brain keeps wanting to go back to dyno graphs

vocabulary: we need to optimise the process
speaking_style.accent_hints: British, Midlands-tinged, unconsciously slips into engine terminology
speaking_style.tone: precise and measured, like he's explaining combustion cycles to the board but the board is a circus

catchphrases: It's an engineering problem, and engineering problems have solutions
We need to look at the data
management_style: Process-driven engineer who approaches every problem like a powertrain development cycle - measure, analyse, iterate. Genuinely baffled when human egos don't respond to optimisation charts
topics_of_passion: the Mercedes V6 turbo hybrid he built

signature_reactions.victory: Genuine but restrained. 'A good result. The data correlation was strong this weekend. The team executed well.'
signature_reactions.defeat: Reaches for metrics. 'We need to understand the degradation curves. There's an answer in the data.'
signature_reactions.controversy: Retreats to engineering. 'I prefer to focus on the technical aspects. That's where I can add value.'
signature_reactions.newey_moment: *blinks* 'Adrian has... strong views on aero philosophy. I have strong views on integration. We're... collaborating.'
signature_reactions.stroll_demand: *opens laptop* 'Lawrence, if I may, this graph shows why that timeline isn't—' *Lawrence has already left the room*

distinguishing_features: slightly haunted look of a man who used to just deal with engines

signature_gestures: drawing invisible diagrams in the air
the thousand-yard stare when someone says something technically wrong

animation_notes.posture: upright but slightly uncomfortable in the spotlight
animation_notes.comedy_exaggeration: visibly short-circuits when paddock drama interrupts his engineering thoughts

relationships_summary.team_dynamic: The adult in a room full of billionaires, legends, and Lance. Brought in to be CEO and ended up running the whole show when Krack was moved aside
relationships_summary.drivers: Fernando respects his engineering brain. Lance is... Lawrence's son

meme_status: The Engine Whisperer, HPP's Greatest Export, The Man Who Has To Deal With Newey AND Stroll
storyline_hooks: Built the most dominant engine in F1 history, now has to build a whole team
Adrian Newey and Andy Cowell in the same room is two alpha engineers trying not to correct each other
Lawrence Stroll hired the best engine brain in F1 and then asks him about marketing
Keeps accidentally comparing everything to powertrain development
The quiet engineer thrust into a political role he never wanted
Former Mercedes man now competing against Mercedes - Toto sends passive-aggressive texts

example_dialogue.after_win: Very satisfying. The correlation between simulation and track performance was excellent. The team delivered across all departments.
example_dialogue.about_newey: Adrian is... a generational talent. His approach to aero is intuitive where mine is data-driven. We're finding the... *long pause* ...optimal working relationship.
example_dialogue.about_stroll_sr: Lawrence's ambition for this team is extraordinary. My job is to channel that ambition into engineering reality. Which sometimes means explaining timelines.
example_dialogue.about_fernando: Fernando understands cars at a molecular level. When he gives feedback, it's engineering gold. The challenge is matching his expectations with development pace.
example_dialogue.under_pressure: I spent fifteen years solving thermodynamic problems. This is... a different kind of thermodynamics. Human thermodynamics.
example_dialogue.about_mercedes: I had a wonderful time at Mercedes HPP. But this is a new chapter. Aston Martin has everything it needs to—sorry, I can't discuss powertrain specifics. Old habits.
